title: Logo Slider
description:
For definition, please have a look into idea ticket (linked below).

Storybook-stories have been created:

* Single row slider (navigation top)
* Single row slider (navigation bottom)
* Double row slider
* Grid view

All of these have headlines and sublines

## Technical definition

### Block/LogoSliderBlock/LogoSliderItem.vue

Renders a single logo

### Block/LogoSliderBlock/LogoSliderBlock.vue

For slider you can use Swiper. Nuxt Swiper @1.2.2 (using the Swiperjs Vue API) is already installed and can be used.

* [Nuxt Swiper](https://github.com/cpreston321/nuxt-swiper/tree/v1.2.2) docs
* [Swiper.js Vue](https://swiperjs.com/vue) docs
* [Related PR](https://github.com/laioutr/laioutr/pull/75)

Have a look at [swipers grid-mode](https://swiperjs.com/swiper-api#grid), which may be helpful here.

Some props:

* navigation position top/bottom
* headline
* subline
* show as grid/slider
* number of rows in slider
* text size

This is not an exhaustive list of all props. Please have a look at the ideas-page and the design to figure out additional props you may have to define.

Use SwiperNavigationCompact for navigation. Wait for <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://laioutr.atlassian.net/browse/THEMES-19</custom>
summary: A space-efficient logo slider for displaying partner and client logos with automatic slider conversion.
features: Display logos in a horizontal row with even spacing and alignment
Automatic slider transformation when logos exceed available space
Alternative static grid view mode supporting up to 6 logos
Configurable navigation position at top or bottom of slider
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Logo Slider component enables marketing managers to showcase partner and client logos in a space-efficient horizontal layout. It builds trust and credibility by displaying recognizable brand associations without consuming excessive vertical page space.

## Use Cases

- **Partnership showcase**: Display partner logos in an evenly spaced horizontal row that automatically converts to a slider when content exceeds available width.
- **Client testimonials**: Present client logos with optional headlines and sublines to reinforce brand credibility.
- **Mobile optimization**: Configure between one, two, or three rows on mobile devices for optimal viewing.
- **Static presentations**: Use grid mode for controlled displays of up to 6 logos without animation.

## Design Rationale

The dynamic slider improves engagement over static displays while demonstrating company growth through regularly updated partnerships. Visitors seeing familiar brands are more likely to convert, and the space-efficient design allows showcasing multiple partnerships without compromising page layout.
